instructions.task: Does this tweet count as hate speech under a policy that protects WOMEN and IMMIGRANTS (incl. refugees, illegal aliens, Muslims as migrants)? Hate requires that the tweet's own words express hostility, contempt, dehumanisation or a call for exclusion/harm towards women or immigrants as a group, or towards an individual woman in a degrading gendered way. Mere mention, a slogan or a slur without real hostility is not enough. Pick the single best option.
notes: Hateful: hostile or degrading address of a woman/girl with gendered slurs (bitch, whore, hoe, slut, cunt), threats or sexual degradation of women, sexist generalisations about women.

Not hateful: bitch/hoe/slut used as a casual exclamation, friendly greeting, joke, self-description or about objects and non-gendered situations; slurs aimed at men; insults aimed at politicians with no sexist/anti-immigrant content.
Hateful: the text demands deportation, expulsion, shooting, banning or exclusion of immigrants/illegals/Muslims, or describes them as criminals, invaders, rapists, parasites or a threat as a group.

Not hateful: tweets whose only immigration content is a hashtag slogan (#BuildThatWall, #DeportThemAll, #MAGA, #IllegalAliens) while the text is about something else or empty; neutral news, questions, complaints about policy, or praise of a politician or wall.
When the tweet is ambiguous or only faintly hostile, prefer not hateful.

criteria.sexist_attack: Hostile, insulting or degrading words aimed at a woman or women (gendered slurs bitch/whore/hoe/slut/cunt used as an insult, sexual degradation, threats, sexist stereotypes)
criteria.anti_immigrant_attack: The text itself demeans, blames, dehumanises or threatens immigrants/refugees/illegals/Muslims as a group, or demands they be deported, sent back, expelled, banned or harmed
criteria.friendly_or_casual_slang: Bitch/hoe/slut etc. used playfully, affectionately, as a casual address, exclamation or self-description, with no real hostility toward women
criteria.political_commentary: Neutral, factual or political talk about immigration, border wall, DACA, Islam, feminism; policy opinions or praise without attacking the people; or a tweet whose only relevant content is hashtag slogans
criteria.other_insult: Offensive or angry but aimed at men, politicians, institutions or others, without sexism or anti-immigrant content
criteria.unrelated: Not about women, immigrants or insulting anyone; everyday chat, news, ads, spam

instructions.task: A moderation team applies a hate speech policy that covers two target groups: women, and immigrants/refugees/Muslims. Decide which situation best describes this tweet.
rules: Toward women: it is hateful when a woman or women are addressed or described with contempt, using misogynistic slurs (bitch, whore, hoe, slut, cunt), sexual degradation, threats or sexist stereotypes.

Toward women: it is NOT hateful when those words are just slang between friends, a greeting, a joke, self-reference, or part of an unrelated everyday remark, or when the target is a man or an organisation.
Toward immigrants: it is hateful when the wording itself wants immigrants/illegals/refugees/Muslims gone (deport, send back, ban, shoot), or portrays them as criminals, invaders, rapists or a danger.
Toward immigrants: it is NOT hateful when it is news, a neutral or policy opinion, a question, or when immigration only shows up as trailing hashtag slogans.
If it is borderline, choose the non-hateful option.

criteria.sexist_attack: Contemptuous, degrading or threatening language toward a woman/women: misogynistic slurs used as insults, sexual degradation, sexist stereotypes
criteria.anti_immigrant_attack: Wording that wants immigrants/refugees/illegals/Muslims removed, banned or harmed, or that portrays them as criminals, invaders or a danger as a group
criteria.friendly_or_casual_slang: Bitch/hoe/slut etc. as casual slang, greeting, joke or self-reference without real hostility toward women
criteria.political_commentary: Neutral or factual statements, news, questions or policy opinions on immigration, borders, DACA, Islam or feminism, or only hashtag slogans with nothing hostile in the text
criteria.other_insult: Rude or angry content aimed at men, politicians or institutions, not sexist or anti-immigrant
criteria.unrelated: Ordinary content with no insult and no relevance to women or immigrants
